module_summary: 8-bit serial-to-parallel converter: a 4-bit bit counter gates a left-shift register on din_valid, transferring it to a registered parallel output with a one-cycle valid.

anchors.name: din_tmp
anchors.why: Shift register collecting serial bits MSB-first while cnt<=7.

anchors.name: cnt
anchors.why: Counts valid bits 0-8; gates shifting and triggers output at 8.

anchors.name: dout_parallel
anchors.why: Output register loaded from din_tmp when cnt reaches 8.

anchors.name: dout_valid
anchors.why: One-cycle valid pulse accompanying dout_parallel update.

anchors.name: din_valid
anchors.why: Input valid enabling counting and shifting; low clears counter.

groups.name: s2p_shifter
groups.description: Valid-gated bit counter and input shift register.

groups.name: output_register
groups.description: Registered parallel word and output valid pulse.
